# archestra_default_user_limit (Resource)

Default token-cost limit for organization members, optionally overridden for one environment. Destroy removes this default and restores inheritance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_default_user_limit" "example" {
  environment_id   = archestra_environment.example.id
  limit_value      = 100
  cleanup_interval = "calendar_month"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `limit_value` (Number) Limit value.

### Optional

- `cleanup_interval` (String) Cleanup interval.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment id.
- `model` (List of String) Model.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_default_user_limit.example default_limit_uuid
```
